title: Tacenta Double Ratchet protocol vectors, version 1
description: A scenario-driven vector file for the Double Ratchet. Each vector is a scripted exchange: an initial state and a sequence of send and receive steps, each recording the message key the model produced. A runner replays the script against an implementation and checks each message key. Diffie-Hellman outputs are supplied as bytes, since the curve is a trusted-boundary primitive.

init.description: Alice is the party that sends first (init_sender); Bob receives first (init_receiver). sk is the shared root key from session establishment; dh_ab is DH(alice_initial, bob_pub).

expect.description: Whether the step succeeds (default) or must be rejected. A reject step carries no mk.

mk.description: Present on ok steps: the expected message key the step produces.

header.description: Present on receive steps: the header the sender produced.

dh_recv.description: Present on receive steps: DH(DHs.priv, header.dh), used only when the step takes a DH ratchet step.

dh_send.description: Present on receive steps: DH(new_dhs.priv, header.dh).

new_pub.description: Present on receive steps: the fresh ratchet public key adopted on a DH ratchet step.
